player_prompt.intro:
Oli muzannyi {player_id} mu muzannyo gw'ebitone, ekubo, n'ebijjanjalo gw'eziri {num_rounds}.
Lakka lya ggwe ni okuzannya n'okuggwa eziri manga.
Mu kuzannyo kw'olu ziri, vuvulira na kimu kati: '[rock]', '[paper]', oba '[scissors]'.
Osiibwa okozesa '[r]', '[p]', oba '[s]' ng'ekibimbu.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kuzaala kwasi kibadde kisembayo. Vuunika [rock], [paper], oba [scissors].

outcome.p1_wins: Omuzannyo ogusooka gwe gwawangula ebitundu ebisinga!
